output.summary: Run is VALID with COMPLETE coverage, but the deterministic verdict is NO_POLICY: both the reference window (1767225600000–1767225720000) and the evaluation window (1767225720000–1767225960000) report NO_POLICY for business and resource, meaning no applicable rule was evaluated; a healthy run does not turn NO_POLICY into PASS or FAIL. Telemetry is complete (no gaps; 7200 overall samples; target held constant at 20 requests/s; p95 latency ~236–238 ms, p99 = max = 239 ms). The only finding is one CANDIDATE correlation (pair-00: resource-00 vs p95 latency) selected with p = 0.001 at best lag -3000 ms (rho -0.962), but clock_alignment is not_verified_by_core, uncertainty is NOT_ESTIMATED, and the load control ('target') was dropped as constant, so no load-adjusted partial correlation or achieved-RPS sensitivity exists. Only one pair was evaluated and anomalies_tested = 0, so other resource series and episodes are uncovered. Advice: verify clocks first; configure business/resource SLA rules and rerun to obtain a real verdict; rerun with a time-varying load profile to enable controls; and inspect the raw JTL latency distribution before drawing conclusions.
